messages:
sam: FYI, release v1.4.2 push to GCR failed during publish: manifest verify failed, missing layer sha256:4b2c...7d11 in destination project.

deploy-bot: publish aborted: 412 Manifest verification failed. Missing blob `sha256:4b2c...7d11` in gcr.io/redwood-staging/us-west1. See logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/12345#publish

anya: is this a cross-account replication issue or did the CI not upload the blob?

sam: CI uploaded to the builder bucket but the mirror step returned 404 when gcr tried to fetch the layer. Suspect IAM or regional replication lag.

infra: can you paste the gcloud push log snippet?

sam: snippet: `gcr: fetching blob sha256:4b2c...7d11 -> HTTP 404 from storage.googleapis.com/storage/v1/objects/redwood-builds/staging/2026-03-20/4b2c7d11.tar`

zach: we have a change freeze at 01:30 UTC. We should not push a new manifest right before freeze. Proposal: pin `staging` to previous digest and schedule republish in the 02:00 UTC change window.

deploy-bot: action queued: `canary-hold staging` requested by zach. Reply `approve` to lock.

anya: approve. Also, add a short-term exemption to object lifecycle for prefix `staging/2026-03-20` if GC would remove the source blob. @infra can you confirm?

infra: can do, but GC holds take ~5-10m to apply across regions. Alternative: retag previous digest to `staging-temp` and run tests off that.

sam: retagging helps test, but eventual publish needs the missing layer. If we repush, we must ensure cosign attestation re-runs and provenance matches.

deploy-bot: note: any retag/rotate will trigger a `--re-sign` step. Publish pipeline flags: `--re-sign --skip-lint=false`.

zach: timeline plan: (1) pin staging -> previous digest immediate. (2) infra GC hold request in parallel. (3) republish during 02:00 UTC window with new object path to avoid alias GC. (4) security to re-run cosign attestation. (5) verify canary then rotate staging.

security-bot: INC-2026-0422 created: GCR publish blocked by missing layer. Security notified for attestation re-run.

infra: I've created INFRA-5128 to hold lifecycle for `staging/2026-03-20/*`. Also verifying IAM logs now.

anya: if GC hold fails or IAM blocks, fallback is to rebuild and push under `staging/2026-03-20-republish-1748780001` and pin temp tag.

sam: rebuild estimate ~10m. Reupload should use `gsutil cp` to us-west1 bucket then `gcloud container images add-tag` flow. Quick command I used for diagnosis:
```
gsutil stat gs://redwood-builds/staging/2026-03-20/4b2c7d11.tar
# returned 404 from storage API, object not visible from gcr fetch
```

zach: I'll update release notes: "staging pinned to previous digest; republish scheduled in 02:00 UTC window due to missing layer in GCR. If republish fails, we will run a manual retag rollback and follow postmortem playbook." 

deploy-bot: deploy summary updated: staging pinned -> sha256:aa77...cc88; pending republish and attestation.

infra: IAM logs show temporary 403s from the mirror worker at the time of push -- looks like a short-lived token expiry. We're escalating to cloud infra to lengthen token refresh window for mirror service. INFRA-5129 opened.

sam: good catch. If token expiry is root cause, republish should succeed after fix. We'll still use new path for safety.

anya: ok going to pin now and schedule republish. I'll be on the republish run during the change window.

security-bot: security ack: will standby for attestation; expect ~8-12m after republish to re-sign.

zach: thanks all. If republish hits errors during the window we'll escalate to oncall and consider skipping today's release.
